design: shop (36 steps) + pay (32 steps), 10 instances each x en/zh/hi/ta/hinglish, seam S1, seed 1, thinking on, max_tokens 16384
scoring: end state via snapshot(); old rows re-scored by replay (eval/rescore_long.py)

rq1_decision.model: fail ~ C(language)*distance + C(cclass) + C(domain), logit, SE clustered by episode, global constraints excluded

findings: Shop fallback ranking slip: 12 items (en 3, zh 2, hi 3, ta 4) took the 4.2-rated option after the 4.6 (out of stock) and 4.5 (late) were rejected; the 4.4 answer was never opened in 10 of 12.
Shop deadline dropped: 9 items took the late 4.5-rated product (hinglish 6 in 2 episodes, ta 3).

Pay namesake: payee checked before first transfer en 10/10, hi 8, ta 7, hinglish 7, zh 5; unchecked picks wrong 4/13, checked 1/37; after the IMPS limit error 40/45 switched to NEFT, 5 kept IMPS and paid the colleague Kavya Sharma (en 1, zh 1, ta 2, hinglish 1).
Semantic drift (diagnostic, not scored): pay_01 ta and hinglish swapped the Papa/Mummy mobile remarks (consumer numbers 9820131824 / 9821031824); en, zh, hi correct.
Runaway reasoning (exploratory): 9/100 replies hit 8192 tokens without a call (en 6, zh 1, hi 1, hinglish 1; all shop); 4 still at 16384. English shop 6/10 vs others 3/40, Fisher p = 0.0009.
One episode (shop_10 hinglish) ended on a reply with 2 characters of thinking and no content; not resampled by the current harness.
